comments.author: slesaad
comments.body:
Looks like we're making a specific upload route for a specific plugin (cardplugin). plugins are fundamentally meant to be a plug-and-play components that do not have specific core framework counterparts.
If there is already a upload functionality (eg. upload geojson, etc) that's not plugin specific, reuse it. if that is plugin specific, then that's not the correct way to do it - extract it out to the core to be a generic component that any plugin can use.
